title: Myridius is the former RCG Global Services, and that rename is the only identity evidence on its row
content:
The Flowable sweep records two facts about Myridius: it was formerly RCG Global Services, and it is based in Princeton, New Jersey, outside the EU scope. The geography closes the row.

The rename is nonetheless worth keeping. Any earlier research, case study or directory listing for this firm sits under the previous name, so a lookup on either name alone returns a partial picture, and a deduplication pass that keys on company name will treat the two as separate firms. That is a general hazard when partner directories are mined at a single point in time: they show the current name, and the evidence trail is under the old one.

Beyond the rename and the location there is nothing on the row. It was mined on 2026-08-18 and not imprint-swept, so no contact or principal was resolved.
